qa.question: Can this Digimon attack if I have less than 2 memory?
qa.answer: Yes, it can. Even if your memory counter moves to 1 on your opponent's side due to this Digimon's [When Attacking] effect, your turn doesn't end until the attack does.

qa.question: Does this card's inherited effect apply even if my opponent only has 1 Digimon with no digivolution cards?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: One of my Digimon has this card as a digivolution card and attacks one of my opponent's Digimon that has 1 digivolution card. If this Digimon has another When Attacking effect that activates and trashes that digivolution card, does this card's inherited effect activate?
qa.answer: Yes. Once that Digimon has no digivolution cards left, this card's inherited effect activates.

qa.question: Does this card's inherited effect apply if my opponent has a Digimon with no digivolution cards in their breeding area?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't check Digimon in the breeding area.

qa.question: Does this card's inherited effect apply when my opponent doesn't have any Digimon in their battle area?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't. Your opponent has to have a Digimon in their battle area for it to activate.

qa.question: Can this card's inherited effect be activated on an opponent's Digimon that only has 1 digivolution card?
qa.answer: Yes, it can. In that case, it would only trash that 1 digivolution card.

qa.question: Does this Digimon unsuspend itself each time it attacks?
qa.answer: No, it only unsuspends itself once per turn. In other words, it only unsuspends the first time it attacks each turn.

qa.question: Does this Digimon's effect only activate once per game?
qa.answer: No. You can use the effect again during your next turn.

qa.question: At what timing does this Digimon unsuspend itself?
qa.answer: After you declare your attack, suspend the Digimon, then declare your attack target. When performing your security check or resolving a battle with your opponent's Digimon, this Digimon will already be unsuspended.

qa.question: Do I gain 1 memory for each Digimon my opponent has without digivolution cards?
qa.answer: No. You only gain 1 memory no matter how many Digimon your opponent has without digivolution cards.

qa.question: Does this Tamer's effect apply if my opponent has a Digimon with no digivolution cards in their breeding area?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't check Digimon in the breeding area.

qa.question: Does this Tamer's effect apply when my opponent has no Digimon in their battle area?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't. Your opponent has to have a Digimon in their battle area for it to activate.

qa.question: If I have two of this Tamer in play and my opponent has a Digimon with no digivolution cards, do I gain 2 memory from this Tamer's effect?
qa.answer: Yes. The effect of each copy activates, causing you to gain 2 memory.

qa.question: If the security effect of this card causes the memory counter to move to 1 or higher on my side, does my opponent's turn end?
qa.answer: Yes, it does. However, this only happens after any attacks end. If there are any attacks that are still continuing due to <Security Attack +> or other effects, those must resolve before it becomes your turn.

qa.question: I have 3 memory, and use this card's effect to gain <Security Attack +1> and attack my opponent. During the check, [ST2-13 Hammer Spark] is flipped over, and its -2 memory security effect reduces my memory to 1. Can I perform a second check?
qa.answer: No. When your memory drops to 2 or less, it loses the <Security Attack +1> from this card's effect, preventing you from performing the second check.

qa.question: My opponent has this card in play. Do I gain memory from [ST2-13 Hammer Spark]'s [Security] effect?
qa.answer: No, you don't gain any memory from it.

qa.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. Can I gain memory from the security effect of [ST2-13 Hammer Spark]?
qa.answer: No, this Digimon prevents you from gaining memory from security effects.

qa.question: If one of my opponent's Digimon has this card's effect used on it and is suspended, can I attack that Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: If one of my opponent's Digimon has this card's effect used on it and it digivolves and now has 1 or more digivolution cards, how does this card's effect resolve?
qa.answer: This card can only be used to target cards that meet its requirements upon activation. So the effect would still apply, and even though the target Digimon has gained digivolution cards, it still can't attack or block.

qa.question: Can I use the effect of this Option card to play a level 2 Digimon that is currently a digivolution card of one of my Digimon?
qa.answer: No. This card's effect can only be used on Digimon cards that are digivolution cards. It can't be used on Digi-Egg cards or Tamer cards in a Digimon's digivolution cards.

qa.question: If I use this Option card's effect to play a digivolution card of one of my suspended Digimon, does it come into play suspended?
qa.answer: No. Since it is played as another Digimon, it is played unsuspended.

qa.question: If one of my Digimon has an effect applied to it that lasts a turn, then I use the effect of this Option card to play one of its digivolution cards as a Digimon, does that Digimon come into play with the same effect applied to it?
qa.answer: No. Since it is played as another Digimon, it is not affected by any effects of the original Digimon it was under.

qa.question: Can Digimon played by this card's effect attack the turn they were played?
qa.answer: No, since it would count as the turn they were played.

comprehensive-0223.title: <Blocker>
comprehensive-0223.text:
16-5. <Blocker>
16-5-1. <Blocker> is a keyword effect that applies a rule that allows a Digimon with that effect to block. (For details, refer to 12 "Blocking")
16-5-2. <Blocker> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-5-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Blocker>, the number of blocks that can be performed during the block timing is only 1.
